description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the TimezonesAPI in the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. It contains test methods for the 'getAll' API endpoint and placeholders for delete and create operations, focusing on integration testing of timezone-related functionality.

classes.name: TimezonesAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the TimezonesAPI endpoints within the OrangeHRM attendance module, including 'getAll' functionality and placeholders for delete and create.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' API method with different test cases, including a version-dependent data modification for PHP >= 7.4.29.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'testGetAll', modifying test data based on PHP version.

methods.description: Tests that the delete method of the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.description: Tests that the validation rule for delete is not implemented.
